reviews.text: My roof looks so good! I appreciate Kyle for taking the time with me when I was trying to decide on what color roof I wanted. He helped me out so much. Also, when my insurance pushed against me for months to not pay for my roof, Kyle was able to get Allstate to agree and pay for my roof.

I recently worked with Kim as my contact at Buford for a complete roof replacement in North Texas.  I couldn't have been more pleased the whole process (visit, quote/roof selection process, professionalism and onsite crew).  The roof installation exceeded my expectations and looks great!  On a personal note, Kim was the first one on site (6:00 AM) on day the crew showed up and stayed onsite all day to ensure the tear-off and new roof was completed correctly.  Kim came back the next day to answer

The entire roofing crew was amazing. They worked around my flowers and shrubs and cleaned up. The roof looks great. The fence crew (3 great young men, who I would recommend to everyone)  also replaced an old gate and stained a large privacy fence. Kim  Lynn worked  with our insurance adjuster (who was also exceptional) and made sure we understood Buford’s contract and saw us through every step of the way. I highly recommend this company.

Highly recommended.  This is the second roof Buford roofing has done for us.  Both times they provided top quality service.  This time around, they also did some gutter work and interior wall patching and repainting which turned out great.  Marty is a man of integrity and extremely personable and easy to work with.  The work crew was polite and professional, and worked fast.  They took several quality control photos and returned twice to make sure all was cleaned up.  The city stopped by unexpec

We had a great experience with Bryce and all the contractors and workers that completed the job. We had roof repair, fence staining, garage door replacement and polycal pergola roof replacement.  The work was completed in a timely manner with outstanding results.

Bryce was our contact to inspect and replace our roof. His input was invaluable in getting a much needed new roof. After having been denied several times by our insurance company, Allstate, in the past, a windstorm caused our roof to leak which literally rained into our home. Allstate was only going to replace that one section where it leaked, but It was abundantly clear that the whole roof needed to be replaced after years of hail and storm damage. Bryce helped us submit and negotiate our claim

Bryce worked with us on a solar project on our roof and did a great job on everything. He was attentive and knowledgeable about the process of getting a new roof with solar. His solar team did a great job detaching and resetting the solar. Would definitely use Buford again.

In more than four decades of homeownership, this was the first time we’ve ever had to replace a roof. Buford made it easy and painless. They dealt with our insurance company, scheduled the work at our convenience and did a quick and terrific job, including a thorough clean-up afterwards!

Buford General Contractors did a great job installing new roof and gutters. Even included ridge vents at no extra cost. Crew worked hard over several days. Bryce was very professional, responsive and paid attention to detail. He negotiated with my insurance company providing a very detailed explanation making sure everything was included! I highly recommend Buford!!

Buford Contractors replaced our entire roof and gutters, added new gutters, and restained our fence and pergola.  The roof looks great - several neighbors concurred - and the crew’s cleanup was spot on.  It was  a pleasure working with Bryce.  He kept us continually updated and expertly handled all insurance communications - at no time after filing our initial claim, were we required to speak to our claims rep or adjusters.  We  highly recommend Bryce and team!
Buford General Contractors did an amazing job! In addition to the roof replacement, additional work was performed with great quality. I am very pleased with their work.

We recently had some work done on our roof and couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the experience was smooth, professional, and high-quality. The team was punctual, respectful of the property, and made sure every detail was handled with care. It’s always great to support people you know, but it’s even better when the work exceeds expectations. Highly recommend for anyone needing roofing work — you’ll be in great hands.

I was having difficulty for 3 mos. with a contractor in the area concerning our roof.  They had determined we needed a full roof replacement.  Buford General Contractors were recommended to me by friends.  Kyle, from Buford came and after thoroughly checking the exterior and interior of the roof gave us a great quote and was able to get the repairs done quickly, and not the full roof but the few shingle replacements we needed. Their team did a great job locating the source of our roof leak and making the repair in a timely fashion. Very professional. I highly recommend them.

Even though he said he re-nailed down the ones that were loose. Literally did not last five days see pictures.

From the start,  Kyle went above and beyond to ensure he understood exactly what I wanted. Bryce and his team are the best!! They came out and provided a very reasonable quote the same day! They were efficient, professional and did a fantastic job! I highly recommend and will use them again in the future. Thank you!!

I highly recommend this company.  I had three roofing companies to my home, all of whom said my roof was needing to be replaced as it was worn out at 11 years of age. Incredible!! Mr. Maury Buford is one of the nicest gentlemen I've met in a long time!! He was so kind, completed a thorough inspection, and then took the time to sit down and go over everything with me in great detail and help me make a well informed decision. Highly, highly recommend!!!
I had my roof replaced and very happy with the results.  I wasn't expecting the job to be finished so fast!  The follow up was great too.

This was a completely positive experience dealing with Maury Buford of Buford General Contractors, Inc.  He completed my roof in a record amount of time with professional expertise and competancy.  A full complement of workers who did the job, as contracted, cleaned up perfectly and went over and above all expectations.
I would grade him and his employees with not just 5 stars, but 10!!!
LynnEggers
Family owned and Faith based.  Awesome team and family.  They installed a new roof for me.  Completion in 1 day, cleaned premises after completion.  Recommend them to all my friends and neighbors.

In April of 2024 I filed a roof damage claim with Allstate, my homeowner insurance provider.  Shortly before I filed the claim, I contacted Buford General Contractors in order to get an inspection of my roof and to get help in understanding the process involved in making such a claim.  Mr. Buford performed the inspection at no cost and confirmed that the roof had significant hail damage indicating that a claim was well justified.  He then continued to accompany me through the entire claim proces

Buford General Contractors is amazing.  We first met them during the build our outdoor living room.  They did an excellent job on the roof, tying it in with the existing roof and matching the existing shingles 100%.  Since then we have had couple of skylight leaks in our main house (old/existing).  Called BGC, they were out the next day, repaired the issues - no more leaks!  HIGHLY recommend!  Reliable, honest and ethical.  That is very hard to find these days!

I contacted Buford Contractors to provide an estimate for a complete deck removal and replacement along with fence repairs. Bryce came to our home and spent a good deal of time evaluating, measuring and gathering information. He was very personable and knowledgeable and sent a very thorough estimate. Thanks Bryce.
I will definitely be contacting Buford in the future again.

We have used Buford multiple times to inspect the roof after hail.  Several times, our roof was repairable and they they did so promptly and professionally.   When the roof finally had to be replaced, we were confident that it was truly necessary.   We will always call them for our roofing needs.

Working with Kim Lynne and Buford General Contractors was a great experience. Kim was very knowledgeable and extremely helpful. I had my roof replaced and some other work on my fascia and fences. He kept me informed throughout the process, and checked on the work as it progressed. I am very pleased with their work and highly recommend Buford General Contractors!

This is an edit of a previous review, based on a subsequent larger job they did.

Barrett answered all my questions, as insurance is pretty confusing nowadays, kept me apprised of schedules and timelines, the crew was early, worked very hard and didn’t leave until it was done. Their work was excellent, attention to detail outstanding and paint matching perfect. Barrett says they have been with them for over 15 year

Buford Contractors installed some tall French office doors for me and did a phenomenal job! The work was high quality but pricing was very reasonable. They taped off the work area to contain the dust and cleaned up after themselves. I will absolutely be using them for more projects and recommend them highly!

My mom recommended Buford since they had done a great job replacing her roof a few years ago.   I'm so glad she did because they did a fantastic job replacing my roof as well! 30+ years of experience! I could tell they’re honest and they know what they’re talking about. They care and that’s most important thing I look for. I’m tired of dealing with contractors that are dishonest and unethical.
Thank you all !!

Buford Roofing were professional and easy to work with.  They were quick, efficient, clean, and the pricing was reasonable. Kim our contact person at the company was always easy to get in touch with and made the project a breeze.  The finish product looks absolutely amazing and we were thrilled with everything they did, including things they did that went above and beyond our expectations!  This company truly knows how to make sure the customer is happy at the end of the day and that meant a lot

After I experienced major hail damage to my roof, I contacted Buford General Contractors. Maury came to my house and talked with me about how a new roof was installed and answered my questions. He conducted my roof inspection, provided an estimate, and later guided me through the insurance process. Maury is knowledgeable, honest, and detailed oriented. This is the second time we used Buford and we again had a great experience. Bryce worked with our insurance and kept in constant communication. Great service and great product!

Professional, prompt and personable. Sincerely concerned about roof damage due to recent harsh weather events. The estimate(s) were prepared quickly. The leaks were repaired by great crew. Preventive maintenance was also performed. Thank you to Barrett and Buford General Contractors

We had interior and exterior work done by Buford and are very happy with the results. They were responsive, reasonably priced and finished everything in a timely manner. I enjoyed working with Kim and will definitely use them again on future projects!
Great communication and service. Made for an easy experience! We will be back for future projects!

Mr. Buford was very patient with me and our problem.  We had a difficult time to find a roof leak and he even came back to help find it "again" without charge.  He was fair on his charges and he even helped find an old invoice to prove to our place's buyer that the roof had been redone lately by him.
